instructions.name: buy_job
docs: Step 2 on the bonding curve. `nonce` must equal the bridge's next
deposit nonce (the Order PDA is keyed by it).

accounts.name: buyback_vault
docs: Buyback vault: receives `buyback_bps` of sol_in (appended 2026-10-18).

accounts.name: share_record
docs: (an Anchor `init` here overflows the 4 KB SBF stack frame of try_accounts).

instructions.name: buy_job_amm
docs: Step 2 on PumpSwap (after graduation): the SOL is wrapped into the
trader's wSOL ATA, spent with `buy_exact_quote_in_v2` on the canonical
pool, and the ATA is closed again (rent and leftover back to the buyer).

accounts.name: buyback_vault
docs: Buyback vault: receives `buyback_bps` of sol_in (appended 2026-10-18).

accounts.name: share_record
docs: (an Anchor `init` here overflows the 4 KB SBF stack frame of try_accounts).

instructions.name: cancel_draft
docs: Buyer abandons a draft (rent back).

instructions.name: crank_buyback
docs: Buyback on the bonding curve (see module docs "Buyback"): the vault PDA buys with
`buy_exact_quote_in_v3`, then the vault's tokens go to `config.buyback_dest`.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone (or config.buyback_cranker); pays the vault ATA rent if missing.

instructions.name: crank_buyback_amm
docs: Buyback on PumpSwap after graduation: the spend is wrapped into the vault's wSOL
ATA, spent with `buy_exact_quote_in_v2` on the canonical pool, the ATA is closed
(its rent back to the cranker if this call created it), then routed as above.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone (or config.buyback_cranker); pays ATA rent if missing (wSOL ATA rent back).

instructions.name: expire_order
docs: Records that the job expired on the chain (M-of-N attesters over
`b"pearl-sol:expired:v1" || job_id`). Funds return over the bridge.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Buyer, admin or an attester.

instructions.name: expire_order_proof
docs: Proof mode expire: the chain's ExpireJob tx for `order.job_id` in a final header.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Buyer, admin or an attester.

instructions.name: finalize_order
docs: Records the job result (M1: M-of-N attester signatures through the
ed25519 precompile). Caller: buyer, admin or an attester.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Buyer, admin or an attester.

instructions.name: finalize_order_proof
docs: Proof mode finalize (see the module docs). `tx` is the CompleteJob tx bytes,
`path` its tx_root path (33-byte entries), `pair` which (evaluator, sig) pair of
the tx the ed25519 precompile instruction re-verifies. Caller: buyer, admin or
attester (result_uri is not proved).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Buyer, admin or an attester.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config (signer = admin) and tops the trader PDA up to rent exemption.

instructions.name: mark_refunded
docs: Marks a Pending (or Expired) Order Refunded once the bridge has refunded its
deposit to `order.buyer` (bridge `refund_deposit`). Anyone may call; the only
input is the bridge's refund record, checked by owner, address and content.

instructions.name: open_order
docs: Step 1: the buyer stores the job spec. `recipient` = the buyer's
agent-chain address (poster of the job; same ed25519 key works on both).

instructions.name: set_buyback
docs: Admin: buyback share, destination, reserve program, cranker allowlist, caps and
interval. Emits every resulting value.

instructions.name: set_buyback_cap
docs: Admin: the mining reserve's token cap for buybacks (0 = no cap). While the reserve
ATA holds less, bought tokens go to it; the rest is burned (SPEC 5.1 "Reserve cap").

instructions.name: set_finalize_modes
docs: Which finalize / expire paths are open (bit 1 signers, bit 2 proof) and the
light-client program whose final headers the proof path trusts.

instructions.name: settle_share
docs: Settles one order's held buyback share once the Order is closed (permissionless):
Finalized -> released to the buyback (crankable); Refunded or Expired -> paid back
from the vault to `order.buyer`. Closes the ShareRecord (rent to the buyer).

errors.name: BadAttesterSet
errors.msg: attester set must be 1..=10 distinct keys with 1 <= threshold <= len

errors.name: BadSpec
errors.msg: job spec outside the configured caps

errors.name: WrongNonce
errors.msg: nonce is not the bridge's next deposit nonce

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: fill worse than max_slippage_bps from the pre-trade quote

errors.name: BelowFloor
errors.msg: trader PDA fell below rent exemption

errors.name: CurveComplete
errors.msg: bonding curve is complete, use buy_job_amm

errors.name: OrderTooSmall
errors.msg: order too small to split into W and P

errors.name: NotEnoughSignatures
errors.msg: not enough valid attester signatures over this message

types.name: BuybackAccrued
docs: One order's buyback share released to the buyback by `settle_share` (Order finalized).

fields.name: vault_available
docs: Crankable vault lamports (above rent and held shares) after this release.

types.name: BuybackBurned
docs: The part of buy `buy` that was burned: BURN_ABOVE_CAP (0, the reserve was at
`reserve_cap`) or BURN_DESTINATION (1, buyback_dest = burn).

fields.name: reserve_before
docs: Reserve ATA balance before the buy's reserve part (0 for BURN_DESTINATION).

fields.name: supply_after
docs: Mint supply after the burn.

types.name: BuybackCapUpdated
docs: `set_buyback_cap`.

types.name: BuybackConfigUpdated
docs: `set_buyback`: every buyback setting after the change.

types.name: BuybackExecuted
docs: One buyback by the crank (curve or PumpSwap).

fields.name: buy
docs: 1-based index of this buy (= config.bb_buys).

fields.name: venue
docs: VENUE_CURVE or VENUE_PUMPSWAP.

fields.name: sol_in
docs: Lamports spent.

fields.name: tokens_out
docs: Tokens (SPL units) this buy returned.

fields.name: routed
docs: Tokens moved to the destination (tokens_out plus anything already in the vault ATA).

fields.name: destination
docs: DEST_RESERVE or DEST_BURN.

fields.name: destination_account
docs: The reserve ATA, or the mint for a burn.

fields.name: quote
docs: Fee-free pre-trade quote for `sol_in`'s cap (the fill check's reference).

fields.name: first_nonce
docs: Orders whose share was released since the previous buy (0, 0, 0 when none): bridge
deposit nonces of the first and last such Order.

fields.name: available_before
docs: Crankable vault lamports (above rent and held shares) before the buy, and what stays.

types.name: BuybackShareHeld
docs: One order's share held in the vault by `buy_job*` (not crankable until settled).

types.name: BuybackShareRefunded
docs: `settle_share` on a Refunded (4) or Expired (3) order: the share went back to the buyer.

types.name: BuybackToReserve
docs: The part of buy `buy` that went to the mining reserve (DEST_RESERVE, under the cap).

fields.name: reserve_before
docs: Reserve ATA balance before and after this transfer.

fields.name: mint
docs: The pump coin (bridge mint).

fields.name: bridge_program
docs: token/programs/bridge.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Share of the bought tokens that becomes P (mining pool), rest is W.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: Max shortfall of the fill against the fee-free quote (covers pump's 1.25%).

fields.name: max_dim
docs: Cap on each of m, n, k.

fields.name: finalize_modes
docs: Enabled finalize / expire paths: MODE_SIGNERS | MODE_PROOF (appended in M2).

fields.name: light_client
docs: Light-client program whose final headers the proof paths accept.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Share of each order's sol_in that goes to the buyback vault (PROVISIONAL default 1000).

fields.name: buyback_dest
docs: DEST_RESERVE (0) or DEST_BURN (1).

fields.name: reserve_program
docs: token/programs/reserve, whose creator PDA's ATA is the reserve destination.

fields.name: buyback_cranker
docs: If set, only this key may crank a buyback; zero = permissionless.

fields.name: buyback_max_per_call
docs: Most lamports one buyback spends; 0 = no cap.

fields.name: buyback_min_buy
docs: Below this a buyback fails with NothingToBuy.

fields.name: bb_accrued
docs: Lamports of order shares paid into the vault, all time.

fields.name: bb_spent
docs: Lamports the vault spent on buys, all time.

fields.name: bb_tokens
docs: Tokens (SPL units) the buys returned, all time.

fields.name: bb_pending_orders
docs: Orders whose share arrived since the last buy, and their nonce range.

fields.name: bb_locked
docs: Shares held for orders not settled yet (settle_share): not crankable, refundable.

fields.name: bb_refunded
docs: Shares paid back to buyers of refunded or expired orders, all time.

fields.name: bb_reserve_cap
docs: With DEST_RESERVE, bought tokens go to the reserve only while its ATA holds less than
this; the rest is burned. 0 = no cap. PROVISIONAL default DEFAULT_BB_RESERVE_CAP.

types.name: JobSpec
docs: Fixed-size job spec (SPEC 4.1 fields). Fixed arrays keep every field of
`Order` at a fixed offset, see `layout`.

fields.name: deadline_blocks
docs: Relative: blocks after the unlock height (see module docs).

types.name: JobSpecArgs
docs: Instruction form of the spec.

types.name: Order
docs: One storefront order, readable by any program: fixed size, every field at
a fixed offset (`layout`). Status 1 Pending, 2 Finalized, 3 Expired, 4 Refunded.

fields.name: deposit_nonce
docs: Bridge deposit nonce; Order PDA = ["order", nonce LE].

fields.name: job_id
docs: sha256("pearl-sol:order-job:v1" || nonce LE): the job id on the chain.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Agent-chain poster / bridge recipient.

fields.name: body_hash
docs: sha256 of the PostJob body the chain must execute.

fields.name: tokens
docs: SPL base units deposited (= W + P in SPL units).

fields.name: worker_pay
docs: W, chain base units.

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: P, chain base units.

fields.name: closed_slot
docs: Slot of finalize or expire (0 while pending).

types.name: ShareRecord
docs: One order's buyback share, held until `settle_share` (PDA ["share", deposit nonce]).
